acceptance: Preserve complete bytes, immutable role/commit/path/blob identities and SHA256 fingerprints for every captured source.
Establish real removal and addition producers and concrete collection/part types using source-supported cardinalities; distinguish bounded unknowns from observations.
Trace normal startup/fixture frequency without fabricated repetitions, many-part lists, isolated membership probes or benchmarks.
Distinguish F229 name-only OrdinalIgnoreCase removal from F230 exact runtime type plus OrdinalIgnoreCase name addition; explain index mutation, order, duplicate, exception and lifetime boundaries.
Read applicable guidance, real producer/test/project source, relevant history and documentation at qualified immutable roles.
Issue independent F229 and F230 decisions; a shared file does not establish duplicate status.
Report source-only materiality and explicit observed boundaries; no-material-candidate is not measured no-gain, false-positive or universal costlessness.
Preserve exact helper bytes, complete native argv/stdout/stderr, waits, exit codes, actual observer/root identities and observed descendant terminal evidence, including failures.
Seal a hash-indexed handoff only after all started source utilities and their streams are terminal; final response follows actual final sealer tool return.
